description: Search the transcribed text of public document pages, by keyword and meaning; each hit links to its page.

documentId.description: Optional document ID (GUID) to search within one document.

query.description: Required text to search for: words, a name or a phrase from the page.

semantic.description: Whether to include meaning-based matches as well as keyword matches. Defaults to true.

sourceId.description: Optional source ID (GUID) to search within the documents of one source.

name: search_page_text
